newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW to sell one-millionth car in China.
newsitem.headline: VW to sell one-millionth car in China.

text.p: German carmaker Volkswagen AG said on Wednesday that it would sell its one millionth vehicle in China this week.

VW, which entered the Chinese market in 1985, said it had sold 863,500 vehicles under the VW brand that were built in China, while another 99,000 were built in China by VW's luxury brand unit Audi AG.

Another 37,500 vehicles have been imported to China, where VW has a 54.5 percent market share and is the top-selling brand. VW is involved in a joint venture to make the vehicles with the Shanghai Volkswagen Automotive Company Ltd (SVW).
